features: Pastel CSS-only light background with reduced-motion support; neutral gray/black dark background.
Shared six-pixel Liquid Glass, including Settings heroes; grouped Settings with dedicated DNS and Update panel rows.
Bounded intrinsic SVGs and early hidden language overlay prevent unstyled black-circle flash; loader fades.
Responsive traffic/content card padding, consistent user action buttons, and tunnel section spacing.
Owner-only AJAX GitHub updater: automatic version check on page entry, explicit install, fixed repository and pinned commit, separate background worker, progress polling and reconnect retry.
Existing backed-up updater with health checks and rollback; exclusive install lock; no VPN restart.

validation.local_checks: Python AST, Jinja, changed CSS/JS, Bash, installer source completeness, SRI pins and JS VM checks passed.

limitations: Publish the complete source to GitHub main. Future UI installs require a strictly newer semantic VERSION; this feature first needs local/SSH installation on older panels.
Auto-check is on entry to the update page; unattended scheduled installation is not enabled.
Requires server access to GitHub/raw GitHub and dependency sources, plus git, systemd and the privileged helper.
Existing 3.7.2 tunnel/DNS limitations remain; see GUIDE-3.7.2-FA.md.
Visual browser approval, fresh VPS installation and fresh Microsoft Defender approval are not claimed.
